company.name: Pronto
company.shortDescription: Pronto is a fast-growing marketplace that provides ride-sharing and delivery services for second-tier cities in LATAM.
company.description:
Pronto is a fast-growing marketplace that provides ride-sharing and delivery services for second-tier cities in LATAM. It is based on a subscription model for the drivers instead of commissions. It was founded in 2017 by Miguel Cano, Gabriel Cano and Nydia Cano. 

Pronto is currently backed up by Y Combinator (Winter 2019) and global venture capital funds.

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,897,330 to $9,581,509, a 5.05x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
